specification.input_notes: The analysis uses DepMap Achilles 19Q2 (figshare 8061398) and 19Q3 (figshare 9201770). The log fold change matrices are in Achilles_logfold_change.csv. The BAGEL essential and non-essential gene lists are in common_essentials.csv and nonessentials.csv. The paper also mentions using the corrected logFC matrix from Project Score, but the deposit listing only includes DepMap data; Project Score data may need to be obtained separately.

specification.comparison_metric: The observed counts of core essential genes from the re-analysis will be compared to the reported counts (650 for SANGER, 942 for BROAD, 519 overlap).
specification.specification_gaps: The exact version of the BAGEL gene lists used for training is not specified. The paper mentions using the corrected logFC matrix from Project Score, but the deposit listing only includes DepMap data; it is unclear if the Project Score data is included in the deposit or must be obtained separately. The exact parameters for the logistic regression and k-means clustering (e.g., random seed) are not fully specified.
